original_sql:
SELECT c_custkey, c_name
FROM customer
WHERE c_custkey NOT IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders)

candidates.sql: SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey)
candidates.rationale: NOT EXISTS is generally faster than NOT IN for NULL-sensitive queries.
